decision.reason: The only evidence is one changelog line [ev-35ba21ac5dae]. It says image-automation-controller was updated to v1.0.0. It does not name the image repository, so the bare name "image-automation-controller" can't be checked as a repository. It also doesn't say what changed or what happens to environments that run the controller, so there is no consequence to tie the exposure to. We can't tell whether every environment running the controller is exposed or only those using certain features or APIs. To decide, we need the controller's v1.0.0 release notes or the image/manifest diff, including the image repository and the previous version.
